description_en: 2+1 typology apartment for sale, with a total area of ​​97.5 m², located on the third floor of a new building in the final stage of construction. The apartment is organized in: Living room + kitchen area with ample space 2 comfortable bedrooms 2 bathrooms Balcony Orientation and regular layout offer natural lighting throughout the day and maximum use of space. The construction is carried out with contemporary standards, quality thermal insulation, ventilated facade and modern installations, guaranteeing comfort and energy efficiency. The New Boulevard area is one of the most sought-after and rapidly developing areas in Tirana, with easy access to the city center and close to all necessary services such as schools, kindergartens, markets and public transport. Ideal choice for residence or investment. High growth potential
